source: icons-src/tecton/*.ts (Tecton icon export); gallery order from tecton-screenshots/059_components-icon__icon-gallery.png
notes: Labels in the gallery carry an 'Icon' suffix (e.g. 'AddCircleIcon'); 'label' preserves the exact text, 'name' strips the suffix. Gallery header: 'Tecton Icons', with Variant toggle (Outlined | Filled), Size toggle (Small (16px) | Medium (20px) | Large (24px)) and a 'Search icons' text field; screenshot shows Outlined + Medium (20px) selected. Icons are listed in alphabetical order, 9 per row. StrataIcon renders in colour (pink/orange gradient top layer); all others are monochrome. `symbol` names the Material Symbols Sharp glyph an icon renders (the ligature name in icons/material-symbols.codepoints); null keeps Tecton's own drawing, which ships in the domain font. 112 entries have no Tecton drawing at all: they exist as Material glyphs only (the seven the generated shadcn components needed — DangerousIcon, MoreHorizIcon, PanelLeftIcon, ProgressActivityIcon, SearchOffIcon, TrendingDownIcon, TrendingUpIcon — plus the 105 added so that every icon the blocks and the docs site render is a Tecton one). Tecton ships its own names and no compatibility layer for another icon set: the two places where upstream shadcn/ui code crosses into this repository translate the identifiers it writes through scripts/upstream-icons.mts.
